Subject: Quarterly demo & procurement timing — request to realign to finance review

Hi Samir / procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week — good discussion about production constraints and the integration surface. We had penciled in a 60-minute technical demo + commercial briefing next week (March 19). Two things cropped up on your side in the sync notes: the CFO will be travelling the week of the 18th and finance is planning a short spend-freeze window as they close Q1.

Given those constraints, it might make sense for us to push the public demo until after Novacorp's finance sprint to ensure decision-makers can attend. Options we have:
- Hold the live demo on the 26th or 28th (post-finance review)
- Keep the 19th slot as a recorded technical walkthrough shared to stakeholders who can’t attend
- Split the briefing: a short exec summary for procurement this week and a deeper technical session after the budget gate opens

Attached is a one-pager on the proposed mutual action plan and a brief product snapshot. If you confirm which path you prefer, I’ll coordinate availability with our engineers and Ben.

Att: Redwood_one-pager.pdf

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: tessa_morgan@redwood.com | Mobile: +1-415-555-0123

--
Tessa Morgan

Subject: Re: Quarterly demo & procurement timing — request to realign to finance review

Tessa —

Appreciate the note. Quick update from our side: finance just notified us of a spending hold for a 10-day window starting March 20 as they complete the Q1 reforecast. Also confirming the CFO will be traveling internationally March 18–24. Between those two items, expecting limited exec availability the week of the 18th.

We really want to see the live demo (especially the cost/latency breakdowns you mentioned). My preference would be to:
1) Push the live demo to the week of March 27 so the CFO and Finance SMEs can join; and
2) In the meantime, could you share a short recorded demo and the mutual action plan so we can get internal alignment?

On procurement: we’ll need an updated mutual action plan and a preliminary SOW to start internal procurement intake once the finance gate opens. Can you confirm if you can hand us a draft SOW and the MAP by EOD Wednesday?

Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Cloud Engineering | Novacorp
